scenarioName: Unrecognised item degrades gracefully, never crashes
description: An unusual item with empty preferences and a degraded assistant (raw item fallback) still yields a plan line without throwing.

input.userMessage: Plan a nonsense item 'asdfqwer' with no preferences and a fallback suggestion.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON ShoppingPlan with a single line falling back to the raw item as the search term.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: A cold start with no learned data and no product hint must fall back to the raw item and never crash.

scoring.passCriteria: Plan contains the raw item as the search term and no exception is raised.
